mentions.name: Embedful
mentions.description: Embedful is a tool for building customer-facing analytics that is easy and affordable for everyone, including people who are not developers or analysts. It is almost launching and is currently gathering feedback from a small user group.
mentions.problem: Customer-facing analytics is typically hard to set up and costly, requiring developer or analyst skills to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Embedful. Goal is to make customer facing analytics easy and affordable for everyone, even if you're not a developer or analyst.
